page.overview:
What is Armor Stand?

Width: 0.5 Blocks Height: 1.975 Blocks Small: Width: 0.25 Blocks Height: 0.9875 Blocks

An armor stand is an inanimate entity that can wear armor. It can also hold items and be posed (but these are not possible in Java Edition without commands).

An armor stand can be broken by quickly it twice, dropping itself and any armor placed onto it.

Two armor stands are found in each taiga village outdoor armory, one equipped with an iron helmet, the other with an iron chestplate.
